<!-- 
Inhibitory testing is performed by maintaining light pressure contact on one area of potential tissue dysfunction while simultaneously assessing a separate tissue (suspected to be neurologically associated with the contacted tissue) for instantaneous TART changes. For example, pressure could be applied to the sigmoid mesocolon while simultaneously assessing a TP suspected to be generated by the mesocolon. A positive correlation would be indicated by instantaneous TART changes in the TP while pressure is maintained on the inflamed organ (for an overview of IT see Ref. [48]). @tuckeyFascialCounterstrainMethodological2025
 -->
